sources.title: Exclusive-Qualcomm to cut jobs worldwide in performance-focused layoffs, internal memo shows
sources.description: Oct 20 (Reuters) - Qualcomm will cut jobs globally in a "performance-focused reduction" following its ⁠annual employee reviews, CEO Cristiano Amon told staff in a memo on Monday ‌reviewed by Reuters, with notifications set to begin in November.

sources.title: Qualcomm lays off dozens of senior positions in San Diego
sources.description: The layoffs affect employees at 11 San Diego facilities, including its headquarters, but no plants will be closed, according to the WARN notice.
